primary_source.read_scope: Entire exact term response including active status, canonical label, exact synonyms and Bacto/BBL formula annotations. No supplier manual independently retrieved for this follow-up.

facts: Frozen maintained Trypticase_Soy_Broth is UNMAPPED_0252. The prior issue1201 proposal already promotes it to MICRO:0000113; issue1227 preserves that primary identity.
Active Bacto_Tryptic_Soy_Broth already has MICRO:0000113, with historical stem-match provenance and a 2026-08-05 absorbed Difco record. The Difco sibling is REJECTED and is not an active collision.
The old ignored-inclusive owner lookup explicitly includes both active Bacto and rejected Difco owners. This is not a missing lookup or a newly discovered absence of an ontology term.

The selected payload differs from the predecessor owner only in mapping grade EXACT_MATCH to SYNONYM_MATCH, mapping evidence MANUAL_CURATION to DATABASE_MATCH and appended history. All formula/component/quantity/alias/identity fields remain unchanged.

Official term annotation gives both Bacto and BBL standard broth the same enumerated base masses and gives Trypticase soy broth as an exact synonym. It separately names the no-dextrose variant and performance adjustments. This supports the bounded generic source interpretation and actual lookup grade; it does not establish product-lot equivalence or justify two maintained owners sharing the ID.
judgment: MAPPING_SEMANTICS section3 forbids treating duplicate ownership as admitted. The root collision gate correctly flags a maintained-integration failure, while its triggering promotion predates the bounded issue1227 grade/evidence correction. It is acceptable to assess the latter without deciding a winner only if the gate result remains explicitly HELD and the exact Bacto owner is named as the unresolved coordinator dependency. No assertion of whole-owner duplicate admission PASS is justified.
required_boundary: Do not change the preserved scientific identity, import another owner, merge, rename or choose an authoritative owner in this bounded correction.
Retain failed attempt log and expose exact candidate/collider before and after hashes plus the unchanged predecessor identity.

Any helper handling must be narrow to this hash-bound preexisting promotion dependency, distinguish correction validation from maintained duplicate admission, and continue rejecting newly introduced, changed or unreviewed collisions.
Final native review and handoff must show a specific concern/hold for this proposal and active Bacto owner; correction support is not integration permission.
